This is a static site (S3 + CloudFront), so every CFN parameter is pure
infrastructure topology (domain, cert, hosted zone, price class, WAF).
'config-only' here means 'skip npm ci + vite build + s3 sync'
(infra/config-deploy.sh, --skip-build). It is a separate axis from
'skip the CFN update' (infra/content-deploy.sh, --skip-cfn) for a pure
VITE_*-only change, which is baked into the JS bundle at build time.
EnvironmentName  — identity of the stack itself.
BucketName       — the PHYSICAL S3 bucket name; changing it makes
CloudFormation try to REPLACE the bucket (serving
the site from an empty bucket), not a config tweak.
WebDomainName / AcmCertificateArn / HostedZoneId are listed together:
the template's HasCustomDomain condition needs all three, and
infra/lib/params.sh refuses a partial set before any CFN call.
